chapters.title: The God of all comfort
chapters.summary: God comforts us in all our troubles so that we can comfort others. Paul explains why he changed his travel plans: all God's promises are yes in Christ.

chapters.title: Forgive and comfort
chapters.summary: Paul urges the church to forgive the one who caused grief. God leads us in triumph and spreads the fragrance of Christ through us.

chapters.title: Letters written on hearts
chapters.summary: The Corinthians are Paul's letter, written by the Spirit. The new covenant brings greater glory than the old, and where the Spirit is, there is freedom.

chapters.title: Treasure in clay jars
chapters.summary: We have this treasure in jars of clay. Hard pressed but not crushed. Our light affliction is producing an eternal weight of glory.

chapters.title: A new creation
chapters.summary: We long for our heavenly dwelling. If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation, and God has given us the ministry of reconciliation.

chapters.title: Now is the day of salvation
chapters.summary: Paul describes the hardships of his ministry and urges the Corinthians to open their hearts and not be yoked with unbelievers.

chapters.title: Godly sorrow
chapters.summary: Titus brings good news, and Paul rejoices that his hard letter led to godly sorrow and repentance.

chapters.title: The grace of giving
chapters.summary: The poor Macedonian churches gave generously. Christ became poor for our sake so that we might become rich.

chapters.title: A cheerful giver
chapters.summary: Whoever sows generously will reap generously. God loves a cheerful giver. Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift.

chapters.title: Spiritual weapons
chapters.summary: Paul's weapons are not worldly but mighty in God, taking every thought captive to obey Christ. Let the one who boasts boast in the Lord.

chapters.title: Paul's sufferings
chapters.summary: Paul reluctantly boasts of his sufferings for Christ: beatings, shipwrecks, danger and daily concern for the churches.

chapters.title: My grace is sufficient
chapters.summary: Paul is given a thorn in the flesh. God tells him, My grace is sufficient for you, for my strength is made perfect in weakness.

chapters.title: Examine yourselves
chapters.summary: Paul prepares for a third visit and urges them to examine themselves. The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
